responsibilities: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Python, SQL, Snowflake, AWS and PowerBI.
Develop visually appealing and interactive dashboards and reports to effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and anomalies, focus on cybersecurity.
Optimize data models and queries to ensure efficient performance and scalability of PowerBI solutions.
Implement best practices for data visualization, ensuring clarity, consistency, and usability for end users.
Work closely with data engineers to integrate data from various sources and maintain data accuracy and integrity.
Provide training and support to end users to maximize adoption and utilization of PowerBI tools.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in data visualization and analytics technologies, recommending improvements and innovations as appropriate.
Collaborate with IT teams to ensure compliance with data security and governance policies.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Work closely with data engineers to integrate data from various sources and maintain data accuracy and integrity.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: "data accuracy and integrity", "clarity, consistency" and "compliance with data security and governance policies" are rigour signals with no velocity language.
evidence.domain_risk: Collaborate with IT teams to ensure compliance with data security and governance policies.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: "Experience in the Financial Sector", cybersecurity KPIs and explicit "compliance" language place errors in a regulated, security-sensitive context.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Work closely with data engineers to integrate data from various sources
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Data engineers, Snowflake EDWH and existing PowerBI estate exist and are maintained, but no sub-team structure is described, so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Optimize data models and queries to ensure efficient performance and scalability of PowerBI solutions.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: A few bullets name tools and context, while others ("Collaborate with cross-functional teams", "Stay updated on industry trends") are generic boilerplate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: provide valuable insights to various stakeholders across the organization
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Audience is unspecified "various stakeholders", end users and IT with cybersecurity/finance context, no single dominant function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Develop visually appealing and interactive dashboards and reports
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs ("Develop", "Optimize", "Provide training and support", "Collaborate") describe delivering scoped work.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure compliance with data security and governance policies
